title: Golden Fox with Poppies
description: A detailed anthropomorphic fox is shown from the chest up, facing right with piercing orange eyes. Its fur is reddish-brown and white, adorned with large golden flowers on the left shoulder and vibrant red poppies on the right, with golden particles and liquid droplets floating around it against a dark background with dramatic yellow light rays.
